verdictEs: Usa OP.GG cuando solo quieres consultar match history desde el navegador sin instalar nada: rank, stats por champion, tier lists y scouting puntual. Usa Blitz.gg cuando quieres que una desktop app te asista activamente durante el juego con auto-import de builds y runas, overlay y dashboard post-partida, aceptando el cliente pesado, el paywall agresivo y la telemetría amplia.
verdictEn: Use OP.GG when you only want to look up match history from the browser without installing anything: rank, per-champion stats, tier lists, and quick scouting. Use Blitz.gg when you want a desktop app to actively assist you in-game with one-click build/rune import, overlay, and post-game dashboard, accepting the heavy client, aggressive paywall, and broad telemetry.

useCases.labelEs: Consultar rank y stats post-partida sin instalar nada
useCases.labelEn: Check rank and post-game stats without installing anything
useCases.reasonEs: OP.GG es web-first: ingresas un Riot ID y ves perfil completo sin descarga, login ni overlay corriendo en segundo plano.
useCases.reasonEn: OP.GG is web-first: enter a Riot ID and get a full profile with no download, login, or background overlay.

useCases.reasonEn: OP.GG has tier lists by role and rank plus the broadest regional coverage in the ecosystem, instantly accessible from the browser.
